author: A Nord loremaster of Windhelm

#Atmora

North across the Sea of Ghosts lies Atmora, the land our ancestors left. Ysgramor sailed from there with his Five Hundred. Before that, the dragons ruled there, and before that, no one knows.

Atmora is frozen now. Nothing lives there, they say. They are wrong, but not by much.

#Why We Left

The sagas say Atmora was dying of cold and war, and that its people came south to find a new home. Some say we were driven out. Some say we ran.

Every Nord feels the pull of the north in winter. That is Atmora calling, the old women say. Do not answer.
